exposure: perceived authority (hierarchical demeanor of a senior physician)
teams' ability to challenge an incorrect order
cohort: Interprofessional pediatric resuscitation teams (n=48) participated in a simulated resuscitation scenario with an infant.
finding: Fifty percent of resuscitation teams followed an incorrect order given by a perceived authority figure, which was significantly associated with both the teams' ability to challenge the order and the hierarchical demeanor of the authority figure.
